query_text: Have any new literary genres emerged in this century?

messages.content: Have any new literary genres emerged in this century?

message.content:
Yes—**some new or newly prominent literary genres have emerged in the 21st century**, especially genres shaped by digital media and contemporary reading habits.[1][2][3]

Commonly cited examples include:

- **Graphic novels** and **manga**[1][3]
- **Doodle fiction**[1][3]
- **Text-talk novels**[1]
- **Flash fiction** and **six-word flash fiction**[1][2][3]
- **Creative nonfiction**[1][2][3]
- **Blogs** and **digital/hyper poetry**[1][3]
- **Slam poetry**[2]
- **Digi-fiction** or **digital fiction**[3]

A useful caveat is that some of these are not entirely “new” in an absolute historical sense; rather, they are often presented as **emerging 21st-century forms**, **formats**, or **labels** for writing that became more visible or distinctive in this century.[1][2][3]

If you want, I can also separate these into **truly new forms**, **revived older forms**, and **digital-only genres**.
